title: Why Spark Shuffles Slow Down Your Jobs

scenes.line1: Why do Spark jobs slow down?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why your Spark job suddenly crawls? Let's talk about shuffles—the number one Spark performance killer.

scenes.label: Driver
scenes.sub: Coordinates jobs, splits work into tasks
scenes.say: The driver coordinates everything, breaking your job into tasks for the executors to run in parallel.
Some transformations are narrow—like map or filter. Others are wide—like groupBy or join. Wide ones trigger shuffles.
No shuffle? Data stays local and fast. Shuffle? Data moves across the cluster—much slower.

scenes.title: groupBy triggers a shuffle
scenes.say: For example, groupBy triggers a shuffle. You’ll see Spark split work into shuffle read and write stages.

scenes.question: How do you avoid shuffles?
scenes.right: Careful partitioning and using broadcast joins can reduce shuffles.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Avoiding shuffles isn’t about throwing more executors at the problem. It’s about smart partitioning and join strategies.
